meta.name: The Penguin
meta.description:
With the city in peril following the seawall's collapse, Oswald "Oz" Cobb seeks to fill the power vacuum left by the death of Carmine Falcone and finally give his mother Francis the life he's always promised. But first, Oz must confront his enemies and his own demoralizing reputation as "the Penguin."

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: After Hours
videos.overview: In the wake of Carmine Falcone's death, Oz attempts to legitimize himself among Gotham's criminal underworld.

videos.title: Inside Man
videos.overview: Sofia works to secure her family's strength, while Oz attempts to play both the Falcone and Maroni families to his advantage.

videos.title: Bliss
videos.overview: Hoping to control the future of Gotham's drug trade, Oz and Sofia must first address the skeletons in their closet. Meanwhile, Victor is torn between his new life and what remains of his old.

videos.title: Cent'anni
videos.overview: Confronting the events that turned her into "The Hangman" – and led to a decade-long fight to survive in Arkham State Hospital – Sofia makes plans for a more hopeful future.

videos.title: Homecoming
videos.overview: With his nascent operation at stake, Oz makes a desperate move to turn the tables. Meanwhile, Sofia strives to build a new legacy for herself.

videos.title: Gold Summit
videos.overview: Despite his enemies' attempts to smoke him out, Oz seeks to expand his reach in the city. Meanwhile, Victor crosses paths with a former adversary.

videos.title: Top Hat
videos.overview: Oz fights to preserve everything he’s built, while Sofia makes a shocking discovery.

videos.title: A Great or Little Thing
videos.overview: Truths are laid bare as Oz Cobb nears the end of his journey and his power struggle with Sofia comes to a head.
